title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): choose from multiple voice styles in voice chats
summary: Hold: the briefing tells administrators to identify voice-chat users through usage reports, but Microsoft documents no voice-specific reporting metric. Its mixed licensing classification and categorical claim that support teams cannot disable the choice for a group also go beyond the evidence. The roadmap details and the documented voice privacy protections are supported.
